annotations.title: Look up a New York LLC

description: Searches New York State's live business register (Department of State data on data.ny.gov, updated daily) by LLC name or DOS ID. For each match returns the entity type, the county on file, the filing date, the 120-day publication deadline with days left or how long ago it passed, the month the next Biennial Statement is due, and the exact all-in price to publish it. Use whenever the user names a specific LLC or asks about their own deadline, county or price. Do NOT use for a name that is not formed yet (use check_llc_name_availability).

query.description: The LLC's name (or the start of it) or its DOS ID number.

name: lookup_new_york_llc
